description: Every Knesset election since 1949 and the first government after it: the day it won the Knesset’s confidence and the days that took, its prime minister and any rotation, the parties holding ministries (ParlGov), the largest list and whether its leader formed the government, or the dissolution when none was formed; and, for each pair of the 2026 parties, the past elections after which they sat in government together. History, not a forecast.
